fichas.title: Public Transport: Conditions and Means of Transport
fichas.summary: Guidance on public-transport access distances, average distances to stops, vehicle dimensions, rail systems and profiles, overhead power supply, and transparent weather shelters. The page also illustrates interchange layouts for urban rail and trams.
uses: Provide public transport access to residential, commercial and industrial areas
Protect passengers from weather while maintaining visibility for safety
Integrate public transport modes with road and cycle traffic
Support transfers between buses, urban railways and trams
furniture_equipment: Advertising panels or City Light Posters
